details.name: MOB.866_MaterialLookup_Item_Attachment_Delete
details.message:
`MOB.866` **Upload a photo and a PDF to the storeroom item, prove each over `/graphql`, delete each through the app, and prove the item back at rest.**
- Fixture: `Central Storeroom` · `000-000-000 Adamantium`. The editable half is the STOREROOM item (`StoreroomItem` `4lZMQZsNNdJ95hoYhd4gYt`); the material item (`pJodNZlMY8Aw08g9hZE8NE`) is read-only here
  and must not change. Both hold 0 attachments at rest, which is what `MOB.865` reads.
- ⭐ **Server-proved both ways**: premise 0 → exactly 1 (named, `image/*`) → 0 → exactly 1 (named, `application/pdf`) → 0.
- 🛑 **Owner-authorised deletes (2026-09-15), this run's uploads only** (trap 2). Nothing uploads unless
  the premise held; the `Yes` / `Delete File(s)` click is made from a step that re-checks, immediately
  before it, that the section holds ONE item carrying the id the server read stashed. The delete
  legs are `always`, so a failed run still removes its own upload.
- ⭐ The photo gear menu on this call site is pinned: `View in Fullscreen` · `Set as Avatar` · `Rotate Image` · `Delete Photo`.
  `Set as Avatar` is never clicked.
- 📄 The PDF step uploads the owner-recorded PDF (`MOB.PDF_Upload_Recording`, trap 12) renamed `DD SYNTHETIC MOBILE 866.pdf`;
  locally a generated one-page PDF of that name.

Wait for the page to mount
Clear this test's sessionStorage keys from any earlier run in this session
Test the "Material Lookup" page rendered
🛑 PREMISE (server): the storeroom item holds NO attachment — so any found later is this run's; stashes the premise flag and the MaterialItem edges count
Remove the server read's sessionStorage keys
